incidente.resumo: An internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests, causing global throttling under Filestore's global API request limit; read-only API calls (Console, gcloud, List, GetOperation) failed for all customers in all locations for 3 hours, 12 minutes, while mutate operations still succeeded. Service was restored after engineers shut down the internal service overloading the APIs.

descricao.texto: Engineers were alerted of the issue through automated alerts on 13 September 2022 at 07:47 US/Pacific.
trechos: Our engineers were alerted of the issue through automated alerts on Tuesday, 13 September 2022 07:47 US/Pacific.

gatilho.texto: An internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests.
trechos: The outage was triggered when an internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests, causing global throttling of the Filestore API.

descricao.texto: Filestore enforces a global limit on API requests to limit impact in overload scenarios; the overload caused global throttling of the Filestore API, and because the quota is global, read-only API access was unavailable for all customers in all locations.
trechos: Filestore enforces a global limit on API requests to limit impact in overload scenarios.

The outage was triggered when an internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests, causing global throttling of the Filestore API.
As a result of this throttling, read-only API access was unavailable for all customers.
This affected customers in all locations, due to a global quota that applies to Filestore.

fatores_contribuintes.texto: The throttling continued until the internal service was manually paused; engineers were alerted at 07:47 and started shutting down the internal service at 10:33, once the nature and scope of the issue became clear.
trechos: This continued until the internal service was manually paused.
Our engineers were alerted of the issue through automated alerts on Tuesday, 13 September 2022 07:47 US/Pacific.
Once the nature and scope of the issue became clear, Google engineers started shutting down the internal service overloading our APIs at 10:33 and the issue was completely resolved at 10:42.

passos.texto: Google engineers started shutting down the internal service overloading the Filestore APIs at 10:33, and the issue was completely resolved at 10:42.
trechos: Once the nature and scope of the issue became clear, Google engineers started shutting down the internal service overloading our APIs at 10:33 and the issue was completely resolved at 10:42.

acoes.texto: Planned: Google states it is taking immediate steps to prevent a recurrence and improve reliability, and introduces a list of action items, but the action items themselves do not appear in the extracted text.
trechos: We are taking immediate steps to prevent a recurrence and improve reliability of the service in the future.

On Tuesday, 13 September 2022 07:30 US/Pacific, an issue with Google Cloud Filestore resulted in all read-only API requests failing for a period of 3 hours, 12 minutes.

motivo_confianca_baixa: categoria_causa: capacity-load was chosen over cascading-failure because the impact came from a global request limit being exhausted by an overloading internal service, with no configuration change. The text does not explain why the internal service malfunctioned. duracao uses the final incident report's 3 hours, 12 minutes (from 07:30); the mini incident report and page header give 07:38 and 3 hours, 04 minutes. prevencao: the list of action items is announced but missing from the extracted text, so genericas was chosen.
